title: starts out great but slows down
body:
this was a really nice app that allowed me to track progress in a simple and pretty way.

unfortunately after a while it became really slow and laggy, it became annoying to try and input data because instead of a quick tap - it was a succession of unresponsive taps and swipes that came to nothing/wrong data input. 

perhaps not for longer term use, but for those who are building habits within a shorter frame period.
author: hannarazif

title: App keeps closing.
body: I downloaded this to my IPhone X and the app can’t stay open. It keeps shutting down every time I load it.
author: samadhi88

title: Nice app :) Heres one request
body: I just recently bought this full version to track my habit and improve lifestyle. I notice that if there's an overall wheel chart(score chart to rate) to give a summary of my selected habits for a certain period of time, it will be awesome!
author: MaxKiat

title: Amazing app
body: Simple to use and to keep track of my daily habits. Checkmarking a day is like giving myself a stamp, and through this app, I am able to persevere so far. Great app.
